description: List every SPL token account a wallet owns: account address, mint, balance, decimals. Use it to see what tokens a wallet holds before swapping or sending. Returns {wallet, tokenCount, tokens}. Cost: 1 credit (0.0022 SOL) after the 27-call trial. Example: {"wallet":"<wallet address>"}

network.description: Cluster to query: "mainnet-beta" (real funds; the default) or "devnet" (test network). Optional.

wallet.description: Wallet whose token accounts to list: base58 public key, 32-44 characters (required).

name: get_token_accounts
